technical.summary: PCG shows strong bullish structure with price above all key MAs and positive momentum indicators, but overbought RSI/StochRSI conditions and weak ADX trend strength create pullback risk; suitable for swing entry with tight stops, not ideal for aggressive positioning.

fundamental.summary: PCG shows no insider buying conviction, no institutional accumulation signals, zero government contracts, no lobbying activity, minimal retail interest, and elevated earnings risk within 58 days.

sentiment.summary: No actionable congressional signal; market in fear zone (36/100) with bearish retail sentiment (52%) creates potential contrarian opportunity, but lack of recent news data and stale congressional trades (3-4 years old) limit conviction.

risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds: inverted yield curve signals recession risk, VIX at crisis levels (229.4) indicates extreme market stress; utilities defensive but credit-sensitive; earnings in 58 days adds event risk.

debate.key_bull_argument: Price above all major moving averages with MACD dual crossover and RSI momentum confirmation provides technical structure for swing entry, especially in fear-zone contrarian context.
debate.key_bear_argument: Overbought RSI (70.9), weak ADX trend strength (20.52), macro crisis (inverted yield curve, VIX 229.4), high earnings risk in 58 days, and zero fundamental/smart money conviction create excessive risk-to-reward for entry.

decision.entry_rationale: Technical structure is sound with price above all MAs and MACD confirmation, but macro environment is in crisis mode with inverted yield curve and VIX at 229.4, making risk-reward unfavorable for new entry.
decision.primary_risk: Earnings event in 58 days combined with overbought RSI (70.9) and weak ADX trend strength (20.52) creates high probability of pullback or gap risk before any upside materializes.
decision.recommended_exit: N/A — skip entry; if existing position held, use atr_trail_1x with tight stops given macro stress.
decision.agent_agreement: strong — all agents aligned on bear case; technical score (7) insufficient to overcome fundamental (2), sentiment (3), and risk (2) consensus.
decision.portfolio_note: Already holding PCG with 43 open Utilities positions (11.8% of portfolio); sector concentration + existing ticker exposure + zero smart money conviction + macro crisis = reduce conviction further below base case.
